WITH daily_category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS product_category,
        fos.DateKey,
        dd.IsWorkDay,
        sum(fos.SalesAmount) AS day_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS dd
        ON fos.DateKey = dd.DateKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON fos.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        fos.DateKey,
        dd.IsWorkDay
)
SELECT
    product_category,
    avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay') AS avg_weekday_sales,
    avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') AS avg_weekend_sales,
    (avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') - avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay')) * 100.0
        / nullIf(avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'), 0) AS weekend_vs_weekday_pct_bigger
FROM daily_category_sales
GROUP BY product_category
ORDER BY weekend_vs_weekday_pct_bigger DESC
